message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: Defendant Wang and his wife destroyed police interrogation record (tear up) and resisted police, causing minor injury to police officer (light injury). Also they attempted to escape, used violent resistance, causing police injury. This likely constitutes "妨害公务罪" (Obstructing public officials in performance of duties) under Article 277 of Criminal Law. Also possibly "故意伤害罪" but injury is minor and caused during resistance; could be "非法侵入罪"? No. The act of tearing record and resisting police is obstruction of police duties. Also "寻衅滋事罪"? But main is obstruction of public duty. Under Chinese law, causing injury to police while resisting is also "妨害公务罪" with aggravating factor of causing injury. So single charge: 妨害公务罪.

Thus answer format: [罪名]妨害公务罪<eoa>.
